protected_invariants.property: The first-party App authority requests only the locked permission set and forbids commit-status publication.
Candidate workflows cannot publish or impersonate any required context and cannot use pull_request_target.
Each protected terminal is static, always runs, and cannot continue on error or delegate to candidate-controlled authority.
Active suppressions are loaded only from immutable trusted authority while candidate records remain proposals.
Sealed security reports reject unknown fields and exclude raw source, environment, absolute-path and secret-bearing fields.
Protected generation has no network, package installation, candidate writeback, commit or push authority.
Exactly one typed App module owns Checks publication and no App source publishes commit statuses.
